# GezegenselCore

> GezegenselCore is an independent mobile app studio. Its apps are published on Google Play: ReFollow (Instagram follower analysis without a password), Anima (sleep sounds, white noise, brainwave tones & focus) and Night Swarm (survivor-style action game).

Contact: support@gezegenselcore.com

## ReFollow — see who doesn't follow you back on Instagram, without your password

ReFollow is an Android app that analyzes Instagram's official "Download Your Information" export (ZIP file in JSON format) on the user's own phone.

- It never asks for an Instagram password, never shows an Instagram login page and never accesses the Instagram app or account.
- Follower/following lists are processed on the device and are not uploaded to any server.
- Shows: accounts that don't follow you back, fans (they follow you, you don't follow them), mutual follows, pending and received follow requests, follow dates, a watchlist, possible username changes and a follow-health summary.
- ReFollow Pro (monthly or yearly subscription via Google Play): full not-following-back list (free shows the first 5), follower changes between analyses, snapshot history, multiple Instagram accounts, CSV export, encrypted backup, PDF report, no ads.
- Requirement: in Instagram, export with Format = JSON and Date range = All time. HTML exports cannot be read.
- Why it is safer than password-based "unfollower" apps: those apps show a fake Instagram login form and capture the password, which can get the account used as a bot, banned for suspicious login, or expose private messages.
- Not affiliated with Instagram or Meta. Not intended for children under 13.
- Available in: Turkish, English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, German, French, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali, Persian, Nepali, Urdu.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.refollow.app

## Anima — sleep sounds, white noise & focus

Anima is a sound and sleep app that blends 37 nature, water, home, baby, and instrument sounds, 8 calibrated noise colors (white, pink, brown, deep brown, green, blue, violet, grey), 25 music tracks, and 7 brainwave modes (binaural beats and headphone-free isochronic tones) up to 5 layers in a single mixer. Includes a sleep timer with 60-second fade-out, Gentle Alarm, 7- and 14-day guided programs, breathing exercises, morning/evening routines, Anima Academy, and optional on-device read-only Health Connect sleep duration. Offline audio playback, no ads, privacy-first on device.

- [Anima (English)](https://gezegenselcore.com/en/anima/)
- [Anima (Türkçe)](https://gezegenselcore.com/tr/anima/)
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gezegenselcore.aura)

## Night Swarm

Survivor-style action game: you move through the dark while your weapons do the fighting. Nine maps, seventeen weapons.

- [Night Swarm](https://gezegenselcore.com/en/night-swarm/)
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gezegenselcore.nightswarm)
